'''2003 Maryland State Championship Scott Lingrell LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2003 Maryland State Championship]], finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2003-04-28).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28620 Lingrell's RTP - MD States 2nd Place]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211003039/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28620&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>
